It provides approximately 7,000 types and more than 660,000 units of rental assets (ownership ratio by category: vehicles 28%, aerial work vehicles and machinery 23%, excavators and road paving machinery 16%, lifting and transport machinery 11%, generators, compressors and environmental products 10%, tools and electrical and surveying equipment 6%, lighting, safety equipment and materials 6%) from the company's 69 domestic sales offices and from subsidiaries in Thailand, Indonesia and Vietnam. Approximately 61% of rental revenue comes from customers outside the construction industry. Within the group, Rent Sogo Service Co., Ltd., Atex Co., Ltd. and Max Line Co., Ltd. handle delivery of rental assets, Sanko Tosou Bankin Kogyo Co., Ltd. and Kanagawa Sekiyu Hanbai Co., Ltd. handle maintenance and repairs, and Rent Trade & Service Co., Ltd. in Thailand handles procurement and delivery and the dispatch of machine operators.
